notes: Read all 116 numbered source lines before editing. This is a dashboard widget rendering a size-adaptive grid of one-tap Tesla commands; every web-only dependency (WidgetShell, DataFreshness, ui.Button, feedback.EmptyState, types.WidgetProps, lucide-react icons, react-i18next) is reproduced inline native-safe following the established AutomationHistoryWidget / ChargingOptimizerWidget idiom in this same directory.

L1 `useCallback, useState` from react -> preserved verbatim (plus useEffect for the inline freshness 30s tick). L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') (used at L35) -> native English-default `t(key, fallback, vars?)` keeping every widget.quickActions.* / freshness.* key + {{var}} interpolation.

L3-6 lucide-react Lock/Unlock/Thermometer/ThermometerSnowflake/Container/Flashlight/Volume2/Loader2/Zap -> no native icon font: each command icon collapses to a 2-char glyph (Lock->LK, Unlock->UL, Thermometer->CL, ThermometerSnowflake->CO, Container[frunk]->FR, Volume2->HN, Flashlight->FL, Container[trunk]->TR) with the exact web hex colour preserved; Loader2(animate-spin) -> RN ActivityIndicator size='small' color #00f0ff (SPINNER_COLOR); header Zap -> ZapGlyph '\u26A1' in #00f0ff.

L7 @/components/ui Button(variant='ghost') -> local CommandButton Pressable reproducing the exact web classes (rounded-lg=8, bg-white/[0.03], pressed->bg-white/[0.08], border-white/[0.06], py-2/px-1, flex-col items-center gap-1, h-auto/minHeight 44) plus the web Button disabled:opacity-50 + disabled:pointer-events-none (Pressable disabled). L8 feedback.EmptyState -> shared native EmptyState (web `message` -> native `title`, empty `message`).

L9 useVehicles + L10 useVehicleCommand imported unchanged from the native web-parity hooks -> identical API paths (/vehicles GET, POST /vehicles/{vehicleId}/command) and mutation semantics. L11 ./WidgetShell -> inline WidgetShell. L12 WidgetProps type -> local WidgetProps/WidgetSize (vehicleId? + size.cols/size.rows read).
L14-21 QuickCommand interface ported: web `icon: React.ElementType` -> `glyph: string`; web `color` Tailwind class -> the exact hex it resolves to; id/command/labelKey/labelFallback unchanged.

L23-32 COMMANDS array — all 8 entries ported byte-faithfully (id, command string, labelKey, labelFallback) with web tailwind.config neon + default-400 colours resolved to hex: lock #10b981(neon-green), unlock #ef4444(neon-red), climate_on #00f0ff(neon-cyan), climate_off #60a5fa(blue-400), frunk #c084fc(purple-400), honk #fbbf24(amber-400), flash #facc15(yellow-400), trunk #818cf8(indigo-400). frunk/trunk shared the web Container icon; given distinct FR/TR glyphs while their distinct purple/indigo colours stay exact.

L34 default export CommandQuickActionsWidget({vehicleId, size}). L35 t. L36 useVehicles() destructured as data:vehicles/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch — names preserved. L37 id = vehicleId ?? vehicles?.[0]?.id ?? 0 — preserved verbatim. L38 mutation = useVehicleCommand(). L39 activeCommand useState<string|null>(null).
L41 isCompact = size.cols <= 1 && size.rows <= 1 — preserved. L42 isWide = size.cols >= 3 — preserved.

L44-54 handleCommand useCallback([id, mutation]) preserved verbatim: `if (!id) return;` -> early return, setActiveCommand(command), mutation.mutate({vehicleId: id, command}, {onSettled: () => setActiveCommand(null)}).
L56-57 visibleCommands = isCompact ? COMMANDS.slice(0,4) : isWide ? COMMANDS : COMMANDS.slice(0,6) — preserved verbatim.

L59-68 WidgetShell wiring: title isCompact?undefined:t('widget.quickActions.title','Quick Actions'); icon isCompact?undefined:<ZapGlyph/> (web <Zap text-neon-cyan/>); updatedAt=dataUpdatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, onRefresh=() => refetch(). Inline WidgetShell mirrors the web shell's two branches: title -> header(icon + uppercase muted title + freshness); title-less(compact) -> children with a compact dot-only freshness overlaid top-right (web freshnessCompact=!title at L89-91,150-164). WidgetFreshness reproduces DataFreshness: isError>fetching>stale>fresh precedence, dot tiers (#34d399/#38bdf8/#fbbf24/#f87171), 'just now / Nm/Nh/Nd/Nw ago' + 'updating\u2026'/'error' labels, 30s tick, onRefresh on a role=button Pressable, and compact (label hidden) mode confirmed against web DataFreshness `{!compact && relativeTime}`.

L69 id ? grid : EmptyState — preserved. L70-78 grid container className (compact: grid-cols-2 gap-1.5 h-full items-center; wide: grid-cols-2 @xs:grid-cols-4 gap-2; medium: grid-cols-2 @xs:grid-cols-3 gap-2) -> RN flexWrap + gutter-padding cells: compact gridCompact(flex:1, alignContent center, 50% cells), wide gridWide(25% cells), medium gridMedium(33.33% cells); the @xs(expanded) column counts are used since a >=3-col widget is wide enough for the web container query to be active.

L79-81 visibleCommands.map -> CommandButton per entry; const Icon=cmd.icon collapses into the glyph render; isRunning = activeCommand === cmd.command — preserved. L83-92 Button props: variant='ghost'/size='sm' folded into CommandButton styling, disabled={!!activeCommand} -> disabled (every tile disabled while any command runs), onClick -> onPress=() => handleCommand(cmd.command), aria-label={t(cmd.labelKey,cmd.labelFallback)} -> accessibilityLabel, the long className -> styles.commandButton.

L93-97 isRunning ? Loader2(animate-spin text-neon-cyan) : Icon(h-4 w-4 cmd.color) -> ActivityIndicator(#00f0ff) : colored glyph AppText (color cmd.color). L98-102 !isCompact && label span (text-[10px] text-[var(--text-secondary)] truncate w-full text-center) -> conditional AppText tone='secondary' numberOfLines=1 styles.commandLabel(fontSize10, width100%, textAlign center). L103-106 close Button/map/grid.

L107-113 EmptyState(icon=<Zap/>, message=t('widget.quickActions.noVehicle','No vehicle selected'), className='py-4') -> native EmptyState title=t('widget.quickActions.noVehicle','No vehicle selected') message='' wrapped in a testID='command-quick-actions-empty' View; the web Zap icon + py-4 have no native EmptyState slot (the bolt signal is carried by the header glyph) — the no-action comment is preserved. L114-116 close WidgetShell / branch / component; default export + displayName added.

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit) clean; npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .) clean; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles green. Companion __tests__/CommandQuickActionsWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks useVehicles + useVehicleCommand and covers: wide(8 tiles + title + freshness), medium(6 tiles), compact(4 icon-only tiles, title-less overlay), no-vehicle empty state, tapping a tile dispatches mutation.mutate with {vehicleId,command} and shows the active spinner while disabling all tiles, and the explicit-vehicleId vs first-vehicle id fallback. Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.
